Abi Ekoku threw 52.54 for 4th in the discus, Ian Tullet and Mike Edwards both cleared 5.00 in the pole vault for 5th and 6th, Warren Caswell high jumped 2.05 for 5th and Lennie Paul was 4th in the 100 metres in 10.68.
Warren Caswell and Hopeton Lindo gained valuable points in the high jump while Abi found that a 55.64m throw wasn't good enough in a high class discus.

Derek Browne meanwhile was getting it together in the triple jump to finish a creditable 4th while Warren Caswell had gained a valuable second spot in the high jump and Fred Salle also gaining a fine second in the long jump.
While we again landed two seconds in the high jump with Andy Hutchinson edging Warren Caswell who was triple jumping at the same time to gain further valuable points.
